Police Scotland is appealing for information to help trace a missing woman last seen in Caithness. Zuzana Gabrisova (48) from the Czech Republic, arrived in Wick by train at around 5pm on Friday October 2, before she was last seen at holiday accomodation in John O’Groats at around 4pm on Tuesday October 6. She is desribed as white and around 5ft 6 inches tall with brown curly hair. What she is wearing is unknown, but she is thought to be carrying walking equipment and a rucksack. Police believe Zuzana may be heading to the Sannick Bay area. Inspector Daniel Jack of Police Scotland North Highland team said: “We are very concerned for Zuzana’s wellbeing and we urge anyone who has seen her since 4pm on Tuesday, 6 October, to please contact us. “We believe she headed to the Sannick Bay area and officers are carrying out extensive enquiries in the area, with support from the Coastguard, Dive and Marine Unit and local mountain rescue teams. “Anyone with information that may assist our enquiry should contact 101, quoting incident number 1809 of Wednesday, 7 October, 2026.” Do you want to respond to this article?
